# Release Checklist

## Code
- [ ] Diff reviewed
- [ ] Dependency lockfile reviewed
- [ ] No debug logging or secrets
- [ ] Error handling and validation reviewed

## Data
- [ ] Schema changes documented
- [ ] Backup and restore plan verified
- [ ] Migration and rollback understood

## Security
- [ ] Authentication and authorization tests pass
- [ ] Cookie/CORS behavior verified
- [ ] Upload limits and content validation verified
- [ ] Secrets supplied through secure environment
- [ ] Logs redact sensitive values

## Operations
- [ ] Runtime and start command confirmed
- [ ] Health/readiness approach documented
- [ ] Monitoring and incident process ready
- [ ] Rollback target identified

## Release evidence
- Commit: [ ]
- Checks run: [ ]
- Checks not run: [ ]
- Approver: [ ]
- Release decision: [ ]
